eyebrow: Real yield vs. inflationary yield, worked
code:
Protocol A -- inflationary yield
  APY 150%, real revenue only $50,000
  New tokens emitted (at price): $15,000,000
  -> backed almost entirely by issuance, not revenue

Protocol B -- real yield
  APY 8%, real revenue $2,400,000
  Paid out to stakers: $2,400,000
  -> fully backed by actual usage-driven revenue
caption: Smaller APY, but every dollar paid out already exists as revenue.
